name: painted-place
description: Build a place in Blender and bring it into the series' painted blue-hour look in one call, with the old-and-used details made from the place's own shape: laid setts and flags, flat stone walls built up into ashlar with dressed windows, puddles where lights mirror, gutter water, damp, stains, rust, weeds, moss and rubbish; then a blind judge says in plain words what to fix, once.
